entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [iOS] Can't deploy MAUI app on iOS local device on VS 2022 #32918

Closed

  • [iOS] Shell doesn’t expose an easy way to enable large titles + translucent navbar #32917

PullRequests

Created

  • [Android]Fix deadlock on modal navigation #32920
    community ✨
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix for Issue #31674: Label with TextType Html measured as height 0 on iOS/Mac #32919
    community ✨
  • [C] Fix NullReferenceException when binding to Dictionary<Enum, object> with x:DataType #32916
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [C] Fix #29459: Switching bindings now triggers propertyChanged correctly #32914
    area-xaml, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix TitleView image not showing on iOS 26 and macOS 26.1 #32913
    platform/ios, area-controls-shell, community ✨

Merged

  • Fix Maui32879Tests expected output to include pragma warning disable #32915
    area-xaml, p/0, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2

Updated

  • Fix CollectionView FlowDirection="RightToLeft" stop working after update from maui version 9.0.110 to 9.0.120 #32318
    platform/ios, p/0, area-controls-collectionview, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [C] Fix binding to interface-inherited properties like IReadOnlyList<T>.Count #32912
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [X] Add warning for duplicate property assignments in XAML #32654
    area-xaml, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • Fix iOS WebView Navigating event not triggered for target="_blank" links #32199
    area-controls-webview
  • [iOS 26] - The MaxLength property value is not respected on an Entry control - fix #32045
    platform/ios, p/0, community ✨, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Switch to SLNX and without switching to SLNF #32714
